2608.03172.title: Surrogate Substitution Preserves PHI Detectability: A Multi-Detector Equivalence Study
2608.03172.paper_summary: Structure-preserving de-identification replaces protected health information (PHI) with realistic same-type surrogates -- "Anna S." becomes "Maria S.", not [NAME] -- so that clinical text stays fluent and downstream tools keep working. But this only helps if the substitution does not itself corrupt the signal those tools rely on. We ask a narrow, testable question: on the spans a de-identifier actually masks, can downstream PHI detectors still find the surrogate? We introduce a paired, multi-detector evaluation protocol that (i) scores utility only on masked spans, decoupling coverage from utility; (ii) uses equivalence testing (TOST) rather than null-hypothesis significance testing, which is uninformative at our sample size (57k paired spans); and (iii) builds a surrogate-failure typology separating fixable generator defects from intrinsic detector limits. Across 11 detectors, 7 benchmarks, and 7 languages (1,750 documents), recall on masked spans moves from 76.1% to 74.9% -- a change our equivalence test shows is statistically equivalent to zero within a +/-2-point margin (p ~ 3e-9), with detector ranking preserved. The residual loss does not reflect detectors getting worse at PHI: it concentrates in malformed and out-of-distribution surrogates (truncation Chicago -> Illino, salience loss Cedars-Sinai -> Vidant). A redaction floor and an open-source surrogate baseline indicate the effect is a property of well-formed substitution, not of one tool. We release the evaluation subsets, scoring code, and an interactive dashboard at https://custodianai.pages.dev so the protocol can audit any structure-preserving transform.
2608.03172.paper_summary_zh: 結構保留的去識別化將受保護的健康信息（PHI）替換為現實的同類替代品——“Anna S.”變為“Maria S.”，而不是[NAME]——以便臨床文本保持流暢，並且下游工具能繼續運作。 但這只有在替代不會損壞這些工具所依賴的信號的情況下才有幫助。 我們提出一個狹窄的、可測試的問題：在去識別化者實際隱藏的範圍內，下游的PHI檢測器是否仍然能找到替代品？ 我們引入了一種配對的多檢測器評估協議，該協議（i）僅對隱藏的範圍進行效用評分，將覆蓋範圍與效用解耦；（ii）使用等效性檢驗（TOST），而不是在我們的樣本大小（57k配對範圍）下無信息的虛無假設顯著性檢驗；（iii）建立一個替代失敗類型學，將可修復的生成缺陷與內在檢測器限制區分開來。 在11個檢測器、7個基準和7種語言（1,750份文檔）中，隱藏範圍的召回率從76.1%下降到74.9%——我們的等效性檢驗顯示這一變化在+/-2點的範圍內在統計上等同於零（p ~ 3e-9），且檢測器排名保持不變。 殘餘損失並不反映檢測器在PHI方面變得更糟：它集中在格式錯誤和分佈外的替代品上（截斷 Chicago -> Illino，顯著性損失 Cedars-Sinai -> Vidant）。 一個編輯底線和一個開源替代基線表明，這一效果是良好格式替代的特性，而不是某一工具的特性。 我們在 https://custodianai.pages.dev 上發布評估子集、評分代碼和互動儀表板，以便該協議可以審核任何結構保留的轉換。
